task.description:
REWORK ITERATION 1: Fix the Zig module system conflict that prevents test-integration-oidc09 from compiling.

Issue: tests/integration/oidc09_jit_provisioning_test.zig needs both bpm_src_mod (for identity_registry, identity_service, pool) and jit_provisioning_mod (for jit_provisioning). But pool.zig is included in both module trees, triggering Zig's "file exists in two modules" error.

Root cause: bpm.zig uses @import("db/pool.zig") (relative import into bpm module) while jit_provisioning_mod has pool as a named module import. When compiled as sibling module dependencies, pool.zig appears in both module trees.

Best fix approach: Add pool as a named module import to bpm_src_mod in build.zig, then change bpm.zig to use @import("pool") instead of @import("db/pool.zig"). Propagate this change to all files in the bpm tree that import pool via relative path.

Testing: zig build test-integration-oidc09 must exit 0 after the fix.

When done, commit and push to feature/WF02-oidc09-20260527.
